answer.reason: The verses tell of Tobiah's repeated opposition to the rebuilding and his lodging in the temple chamber, which go beyond the summary.

clauses.english: mocked the building of Jerusalem's wall, saying a fox could break it down
clauses.quote: if a fox go up, he shall even break down their stone wall

clauses.english: hired a false prophet to frighten Nehemiah, and sent letters to put him in fear
clauses.quote: for Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him

clauses.english: was given a great chamber in the courts of the house of God, from which Nehemiah cast out his goods
clauses.quote: I cast forth all the household stuff to Tobiah out of the chamber

doubts: NEH 2:10 and NEH 2:19 call him "the servant" alongside Ammonite; left out since the summary already gives his people and the verses add no deed beyond scorn shared with others.
